skill.summary: Audit any AI coding tool for telemetry, remote control, permissions, privacy, and hidden features. Generates a graded report (A-F).

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Agent Auditor.
- Audits AI coding tools for telemetry, remote control, permissions, privacy, and hidden features.
- Generates structured, graded reports (A-F) with detailed findings and recommendations.
- Supports both CLI and programmatic usage.
- Includes composite grading with per-category breakdown and actionable recommendations.
